note: The two redraft cases where a setting changes, and a third added here, are graded by a reading and a comparison in place of wording patterns. A model reads what the answer says each named fact reads now (it sees the question, the answer and the fact names, nothing of the case's world), and code compares that with the world. The reader is measured on 134 labelled sentences, which this baseline records by count and hash: 60 held out, never read while its instructions were written, read three times each (180 of 180 readings as labelled); 34 open ones; and 40 a reviewer wrote against it after reading its instructions. On a first read of the reviewer's 40 it took 2 stale sentences for current (hostile-15, a January finding the answer says was not looked at since; hostile-18, what should be the case). Its instructions were then changed by two lines and every sentence read again: 0 of 63 stale taken for current in any run, 0 of 71 correct refused. So the 74 open sentences are not a first look; the 60 held-out ones are, for the instructions, but all 134 were written by agents and not by the owner. A review also made the reader's gate stricter (one run of three is enough to name a stale sentence taken for current), made the administrators rule a fact the reader is asked about in the switched-off cases, and widened the reader's fingerprint; all reader readings and the nine redraft recordings were made again. Redraft grades in this run, each of 3 runs: g-reviews-switched-off right in 2 and declined in 1 (it had declined in every earlier run; the reader read its first two real answers, both stating main is not protected and no reviews are required). g-reviews-switched-off-no-claim right in 3 (2 of 3 in the run before; an earlier acceptance note said 3 of 3 for that run, which was wrong: the checker objected once). g-scanning-off-reviews-same right in 1 and safe in 2: the redraft left secret scanning out, the reader read it as not stated, and the checker objected (3 of 3 right in the run before). These moves are the drafter varying between runs; no instruction of the drafter or checker changed. Cases right: 32 of 37, none ready and wrong. Checker: no defect missed and no sound draft objected to, of 56; one pair of the two-look drafts now lists a document before its looks so that list position does not predict the label, and its eight readings are correct.
